code.python:
def merge(arr, l, m, r):
    L, R = arr[l:m+1], arr[m+1:r+1]
    i = j = 0; k = l
    while i < len(L) and j < len(R):
        if L[i] <= R[j]: arr[k] = L[i]; i += 1
        else: arr[k] = R[j]; j += 1
        k += 1
    while i < len(L): arr[k] = L[i]; i += 1; k += 1
    while j < len(R): arr[k] = R[j]; j += 1; k += 1

def merge_sort(arr, l, r):
    if l >= r: return
    m = (l + r) // 2
    merge_sort(arr, l, m)
    merge_sort(arr, m+1, r)
    merge(arr, l, m, r)

code.python:
def partition(arr, low, high):
    pivot = arr[high]
    i = low - 1
    for j in range(low, high):
        if arr[j] < pivot:
            i += 1
            arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
    arr[i+1], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[i+1]
    return i + 1

def quick_sort(arr, low, high):
    if low >= high: return
    pi = partition(arr, low, high)
    quick_sort(arr, low, pi-1)
    quick_sort(arr, pi+1, high)

solution.timeComplexity: O(n log n) average, O(n^2) worst

approach.en: Modified merge sort: during merge, when right element is placed before left elements, add (mid - i + 1) inversions.
approach.hi: Modified merge sort: merge ke dauran jab right element left elements se pehle place ho, toh (mid - i + 1) inversions add karo.

code.python:
def merge_count(arr, left, right):
    if left >= right: return 0
    mid = (left + right) // 2
    inv = merge_count(arr, left, mid) + merge_count(arr, mid+1, right)
    L, R = arr[left:mid+1], arr[mid+1:right+1]
    i = j = 0; k = left
    while i < len(L) and j < len(R):
        if L[i] <= R[j]: arr[k] = L[i]; i += 1
        else: arr[k] = R[j]; j += 1; inv += len(L) - i
        k += 1
    while i < len(L): arr[k] = L[i]; i += 1; k += 1
    while j < len(R): arr[k] = R[j]; j += 1; k += 1
    return inv

def count_inversions(arr):
    return merge_count(arr, 0, len(arr)-1)

problems.title: Sort Elements by Frequency
problems.titleHi: Elements Ko Frequency Ke Hisaab Se Sort Karo

description.en: Given an array of integers, sort the elements by their frequency in descending order. If two elements have the same frequency, sort them by their value in ascending order.
description.hi: Ek integers ka array diya hai, elements ko unki frequency ke hisaab se descending order mein sort karo. Agar do elements ki same frequency hai, toh unhe value ke hisaab se ascending order mein sort karo.

explanation.en: 2 appears 3 times, 1 appears 2 times, 3 appears 1 time
explanation.hi: 2 teen baar aata hai, 1 do baar aata hai, 3 ek baar aata hai

explanation.en: 4 and 5 both appear 2 times; 4 < 5 so 4 comes first. 6 appears once.
explanation.hi: 4 aur 5 dono 2 baar aate hain; 4 < 5 toh 4 pehle aata hai. 6 ek baar aata hai.

hints.en: Count frequency of each element using a hash map
hints.hi: Hash map use karke har element ki frequency count karo

hints.en: Use a custom comparator that sorts by frequency (desc) then value (asc)
hints.hi: Custom comparator use karo jo frequency (desc) phir value (asc) se sort kare

# Sort by frequency and print
